fact: At a study day in Chlef wilaya, ASAL experts presented satellite-based agricultural work including yield forecasting from satellite images in Sidi Bel Abbes and irrigated-area mapping from Alsat-2, and the day's recommendations proposed a satellite-based GIS for the wilaya's agricultural services directorate to follow farming systems and forecast yields.
title: Recommandations de la journée d'étude Wilaya de Chlef - Agence Spatiale Algérienne
